GRADE 8 KISWAHILI — TERM 3 EXAM

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: KISWAHILI
Time: 64 minutes

INSTRUCTIONS
1. Answer all questions.
2. Use neat handwriting.
2. For multiple choice, write the correct letter only.
3. For short answers, write clearly in the spaces provided.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A: Multiple Choice

   C. Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 11.1.1 Kuzungumza kwa Kutumia Vidokezo vya Hoja is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 11.1.1 Kuzungumza kwa Kutumia Vidokezo vya Hoja.

2. About Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 11.1.1 Kuzungumza kwa Kutumia Vidokezo vya Hoja nyumbani na wazazi, which statement is correct?
